mechanism_narrative: A 1-month increase in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations by increasing the risk-free rate, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25 percentage points (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPI) exceeds 300.0, it signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 300.0) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 300.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market, defined by unemployment rate below 3.5% and monthly payroll growth exceeding 0.5%, signals strong economic momentum that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5 and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% (m/m) (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300, it signals strong residential demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1300 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high housing starts (HOUST > 1300) and rising industrial production (INDPRO growth > 0.5% m/m) signals robust economic demand and supply conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1300 and INDPRO growth > 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high residential investment (RSAFS > 650000) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1300) signals a strong housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 650000 and HOUST > 1300 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).
